dsm5: Major Depressive or Bipolar Disorder With Psychotic Features

description.en: Delusions or hallucinations occurring exclusively during major depressive, manic, or hypomanic episodes
description.hi: प्रमुख अवसादी, मैैनिक या हाइपोमैैनिक एपिसोड के दौरान ही उत्पन्न भ्रम या मतिभ्रम

mappingNote: MINI Module K separates psychosis restricted to mood episodes from primary psychotic disorder; ICD-11 encodes psychotic features within the mood-disorder chapter rather than 6A20-6A24.
